summary: A Yes vote authorizes Natomas Unified School District to issue $300,000,000 in bonds, repaid by a property tax of about $60 per $100,000 of assessed value, to repair and upgrade school facilities.

tax.text: A Yes vote authorizes up to $300 million in local bond funding for school facility improvements and expansion.
tax.quote: would authorize up to $300 million in locally controlled funding to repair aging schools, expand capacity for a growing community, and modernize classrooms and learning spaces

schools.text: A Yes vote provides bond funding for repairs, expansion, and modernization of Natomas Unified School District schools.
schools.quote: would authorize up to $300 million in locally controlled funding to repair aging schools, expand capacity for a growing community, and modernize classrooms and learning spaces

tax.text: A No vote does not authorize the Measure D bond funding for those school facility improvements.
